title: mana2/1 payload
description: A parsed mana2 .jsonc layout object (vendor/mana2/docs/layouts.md), minus comments/trailing commas (already stripped by formats/mana2/1/jsonc.ts before this schema ever sees it). `layout.fingers`/`fingermap` are whitespace-tokenized row strings (single OR double space between tokens, either is just visual -- see core/load_layout.go's Fields()-based tokeniser); the per-row shape agreement between them (same or fewer fingers tokens than fingermap tokens, one-digit fingermap values) is a semantic check in formats/mana2/1/index.ts's validate(), not expressible here. `board.mirrorLeftRowStagger`/`board.splitAngle` and `magic.magicKeys`/`layers` are mana2 features akl/1 has no idiom for (magicKeys is an unused/legacy field even in mana2 itself -- see load_layout.go's addMagicDirectionals TODO; layers are 'todo' in mana2's own docs) -- carried through same-format round trips and, for a record translated from akl/1, recovered from `x.mana2` (01-format.md §6.3's own escape-hatch pattern for `x.cmini`).
